violations.requirement: The resulting pointer must be in bounds of (or one past the end of) the same allocated object, and the offset computation must not overflow isize.
violations.explanation: The offset and len come from the safe public MmapMut::flush_range. The offset is not checked against the map length. A large or out-of-range offset makes self.ptr.offset(offset - alignment) leave the mapped allocation, which is UB.

violations.requirement: The resulting pointer must be in bounds of (or one past the end of) the same allocated object, and the offset computation must not overflow isize.
violations.explanation: The offset comes from the safe public MmapMut::flush_async_range and is never checked against the map length. self.ptr.offset(aligned_offset as isize) can then go out of bounds or overflow isize, which is UB.
